recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度極高，紅血球系與顆粒球系前驅細胞密集增生，並散在許多大小懸殊、核分葉過多的巨核細胞，部分鬆散成群；三系增生而無纖維化，符合真性紅血球增多症增生期。
features: Hypercellular marrow with markedly reduced fat
Panmyelosis with abundant erythroid precursors (round dark nuclei) and granulocytic precursors
Numerous megakaryocytes of widely varying size, many large with hyperlobated nuclei, occasionally in loose clusters
No prominent hyperchromatic cloud-like megakaryocyte nuclei
No fibrosis or sinusoidal streaming evident
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage proliferation. Megakaryocytes are markedly increased and pleomorphic, including large forms with hyperlobated nuclei arranged singly and in loose clusters. Erythroid and granulocytic precursors are expanded with preserved maturation. There is no evident fibrosis or excess blasts in this field. Findings are consistent with polycythemia vera, proliferative (polycythemic) phase.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are predominantly giant with staghorn nuclei in a normocellular marrow without erythroid and granulocytic proliferation.
Megakaryocytes form tight clusters with bulbous hyperchromatic nuclei and aberrant maturation, and erythropoiesis is reduced.
Megakaryocytes are increased but show normal morphology and distribution without panmyelosis or JAK2 mutation.
